platform: macOS desktop application using the existing TypeScript and React core with Tauri.
gameplay: One main game with optional built-in player cheats; no separate practice mode. Ordinary wild encounters use capsule capture. Simplify acquisition instead of reproducing complex classic tasks; place base forms on source-supported canonical maps where practical, with clear challenge or task rewards for alternatives.
bosses: Available at any time. Preserve named challenge rewards and simplify difficult acquisition requirements.
opponent_ai: Implement smarter fully offline local battle decisions and coordinated NPC teams before other proposed features. Use observable battle history and visible state, not pending player input or hidden builds. Preserve authored boss scripts and ordering. New ordinary-stat trainer teams may explicitly opt into tactical switching and replacement selection, with offense, control and attrition styles. Trainer encounters grant currency and experience without changing existing collection routes or recruitment prerequisites. Other proposed cups, presets, release tools and collection goals remain deferred.

acquisition.planning_unit: An evolution family, with its base form and higher forms assessed together. An ancestry relationship alone does not prove an executable evolution.
acquisition.route_priority: Source-supported map placements and simple direct capsule capture; avoid complex historical equipment, timers, lotteries and task chains. A Foundin location alone does not establish a free encounter for a paid/VIP/lottery family: preserve that visible location as a link to its collection task. Independently evidenced wild, boss and breeding routes remain valid.
acquisition.npc_exclusions: Exclude the entire Incaros family (122, 123, 124) and Saggros (125) from normal collection planning; the modifier remains available.
acquisition.encyclopedia: Locate only actual initial-form acquisition entries along the selected form's directed ancestry. Show required evolution separately. An adult or sibling reward route must not substitute for a missing initial-form entry.
acquisition.paid_recruitment: All paid, VIP and lottery acquisition routes become explicit prerequisite-creature collection rewards that grant essence items. Design these together with named boss-clear rewards; no payments are implemented. Preserve the existing exclusions of divine beasts, Puni and NPC partner families from prerequisite selection.
acquisition.repeat_paid: Source-confirmed repeatable acquisition remains repeatable through essence claims. Preserve affirmative whole-species lifetime limits; individual encounter flags are not whole-species evidence. Historical unknowns remain labeled unknown in the source manifest; as an explicit remake rule, allow bounded repeat claims rather than inventing an historical limit. Every new essence claim, capture, shop replenishment, fusion/breeding result and evolution respects the six-copy ceiling, counting held monsters plus all unhatched aliases. Existing surplus save data is preserved.
acquisition.collection_credit: Obtaining a higher form marks every directed lower ancestor as owned/seen without creating extra monsters or sibling credit. Repair existing saves immediately. Level edits use the same normal automatic-evolution policy as pooled experience.
acquisition.recruitment_limits: At most six copies of the same species, counting held monsters plus all pending essence/fusion-bead aliases when issuing new rewards. Hatching converts one existing reservation and cannot create more than six held monsters. Evolution frees the old form allowance and reserves the new form allowance. At most six prerequisite conditions total per reward, counting creature collection and named boss defeats together. The user explicitly selected both limits on 2026-10-14.

mechanics.fusion: Use source-backed primary and secondary families. Retain both actual parents and generate one spirit bead without materials, currency, energy collection or waiting. Spirit beads reuse immediate essence hatching. Karu and Hige each have a 5 percent chance; the three beige-bead infants are equally likely. Fix the output when fusing and persist it across reloads. Display probabilities before fusion and distinguish recipes whose parent acquisition routes remain missing.
mechanics.fifth_skill: Include a module interface; populate data later.
mechanics.soul_mark: Include a module interface; populate data later.
mechanics.engravings: Include a module interface; populate data later.
mechanics.critical_hits: Keep ordinary random critical hits (baseline 1/16, multiplier 2); add visible impact, damage and log feedback. Hui Xin and Mian Bao use explicitly documented remake calibration rather than an unverified original rate.
mechanics.cooperative_pve: Use ordinary solo creature challenges instead of cooperative PvE encounters, including Seville. Preserve ordinary player rosters and sequential opponent campaigns.
mechanics.breeding: Allow only the eight complete official retained mature-form pairs, fixed species genders, levels at least50 and first-generation males. Preserve both owned parents and immediately generate one level1 generation1 infant using the exact original three-outcome probabilities. The user explicitly selected free breeding without waiting or chamber recharge. Do not invent numerical IV, nature, trait or move inheritance.
mechanics.item_shop: Use one classified free laboratory shop for all ordinary backpack items and every earned essence/fusion bead. Include zero-stock ordinary supplies and retain earned-product unlocks after consumption and reload. Do not expose unearned hidden generic recruit essences as new routes.
mechanics.official_capture_alignment: Use the official capsule factors and original species CatchRate metadata; enforce the original Niao active-partner prerequisite. Full server probability and encounter catchType remain unverified; do not replace the existing reconstruction with an unsupported formula.
mechanics.official_damage_alignment: Retained official single/composite type coefficients and nature multipliers are verified. Full server damage/stat rounding, random/critical details and other undocumented factors remain unverified; preserve explicit source boundaries.
mechanics.evolution: Source-confirmed ordinary mechanical evolution uses original level thresholds without evolution chambers or item gates. All 32 special and super-evolution transitions require explicit player confirmation, even for a single target. Retain the meaningful source thresholds 63, 34 and 40; replace the three original item-trigger Lv.1 thresholds with explicitly documented remake Lv.60 gates. Other special thresholds remain 60, then 70 and 80 for successive special stages. Multi-target evolution always requires explicit branch selection, even if only one target is level-eligible. Preserve ordinary chains and repeatable branch-family capture or essence routes under the shared six-copy allowance. Evolution frees the source-form allowance and checks the selected destination allowance.

presentation.monster_art: Download original portraits first; generate original replacements only when originals cannot be obtained.
presentation.monster_art_quality: Recover original vector assets for low-resolution portraits when available; measure silhouette bounds and scale evolution stages coherently. Correct vector viewports using their own measured silhouettes, including Rei.
presentation.battle: Classic battle, item, creature and escape modules. Non-capturable encounters omit capsules. Keep names in health panels, without duplicate labels below portraits.
presentation.animation: Use recovered offline original action clips for all 1483 retained species, with skill effects and presentation ordered by actual engine events.
presentation.shell: Recover the official blue bottom navigation rail, original navigation and mission/SPT artwork, classic window chrome and source scene-name plate. Keep eight efficient gameplay tools accessible; place developer modifiers in settings. Omit social chat and player-base interfaces. Scale one 960-by-650 frame to the actual host.
presentation.fusion_entry: Bind fusion to the original left rear chamber in the laboratory and breeding to the separate right rear chamber. Preserve the central shop, Dr. Pat interaction, and encyclopedia links to the relevant laboratory function.
presentation.battle_loading: Load actual battle portraits and the scene background with a progress indicator; retain a brief cached transition.
presentation.battle_return: Complete the final action animation, then return automatically to the initiating map or campaign scene. Retain player position, clear the previous encounter dialogue, and repeat the result as a brief scene message.
presentation.challenge_archive: Remove the duplicate long-campaign category while retaining legendary campaigns and task training in their corresponding categories. Order Brave Tower by floor number and Dark Arena by door number; keep other categories ordered by species number.
presentation.battle_log: Group each action with damage, remaining HP, status and stage changes in the original-style left record panel and its expandable scrolling history.
presentation.robots: Use recovered classic Seer robot layers with eight original directional poses and original twelve-frame walking cycles, and official NPC-configured captain/scientist parts. Both feet alternate while moving and restore the standing pose at rest; no perspective rotations of a front image.
presentation.capture: Show a cylindrical capsule first, then draw in the creature, close/shake, and finally display the actual capture outcome.
presentation.battle_background: Freeze the actual rendered entry-scene picture and render it as the lowest battle-arena layer, independent of navigation persistence. Campaign entries reuse their existing mapped rendezvous picture in both the stage interface and battle.
presentation.laboratory_interfaces: Use the original painted chamber machinery with separate bounded hit targets and raised cream/gold Hei labels following the original item-menu style. Remove floating authored emblems and Dr. Pat overhead marker. Preserve background/NPC layers and bounded breeding sidebar scrolling.
presentation.official_ui: Use original official-client UI skins for shared management, atlas, breeding and battle presentation. Match the classic battle record/2-by-2 skill/diamond-command arrangement while retaining efficient mechanics, immediate free transactions and explicit confirmations. Document source hashes and layout adaptations; do not claim a pixel-exact recreation of a single historical client.
presentation.typography: Use recovered SimSun/Songti live text and original outlined icon captions. Developer previews may load locally installed matching SimSun and SimHei faces from ignored cache only. Keep ordinary player/NPC names free of authored backing cards; laboratory facility logos are raised cream/gold Hei captions following the original item-menu treatment.
presentation.atlas: Use one original-art graphical tree: universe overview, one selected galaxy, then a planet landing diagram. Show only the current level and a return arrow, with direct leaf travel. Remove simultaneous ancestor tabs, the right preview and the separate confirmation footer. Keep all modeled ship/station/fortress and challenge staging destinations reachable; document composed layouts separately from native source geometry.
presentation.petbag: Use the recovered official PetBag frame and aspect ratio, enlarged to fit the scene. Keep staggered left icon navigation, a larger normalized central portrait, four right-side detail tabs and six normalized bottom party previews with small attribute icons, visible level and useful HP. Expand the source slot frame's interior with nine-slice edges around the existing portrait size and breathing animation. Show pink female/blue male symbols below the portrait level, omit generation and party-count displays, remove duplicate identity rows and provide skill editing through the single left shortcut. Preserve raising actions and searchable eight-item warehouse pages.
presentation.task_pages: Paginate journey and SPT recruitment task cards with persistent previous/next and page selection; preserve all rewards, requirements and focused encyclopedia routes.
presentation.dex_attribute_filter: Add original single and composite attribute icons to the encyclopedia attribute filter and its selected value.
presentation.modifier: Place the developer modifier above the entire game frame and footer. Keep an explicit held-instance selector and persistent named portrait/level/species/location target header above the bounded scrollable editor.
presentation.monster_skins: Every owned individual across the complete 1,483-species catalog has the skin feature, including initial, ordinary, mechanical, branching, special and modifier-only forms. A form with no directed ancestors still exposes its own default appearance; no additional costume or higher form is invented. Each individual can freely use its current form or any directed ancestor form as a cosmetic skin, without changing actual species, names, stats, types, skills, breeding, recruitment, collection credit or copy limits. Exclude sibling branches, later descendants and unrelated forms. Use the chosen appearance consistently for owned-instance portraits, motion, sizing, preload and battle timing. Ordinary evolution and same-species restoration preserve valid skins; battle transformations temporarily take precedence. Missing or invalid optional skin save data falls back to the real form without replacing the save.

execution: Development/debug work only. Validate focused behavior through TypeScript, controller checks and the development preview. Do not package or rebuild a distributable unless the user explicitly requests it again. Preserve existing saves and historical releases.
team: Root agent plus three GPT-6.1 Sol subagents at medium reasoning effort.
exploration: Five selectable galaxies with planet and landing-region selection. More than 90 percent of each map accepts player movement clicks; route geometry does not block interaction. Ordinary creatures use broad random straight/curved excursions and varied pauses within measured visible bounds. Each rare or simplified special species appears once per scene. Creature labels show their actual encounter level rather than wild status. Creature turns use instantaneous horizontal mirroring only. Scene arrows follow recovered doorway positions where available, show destination text only on hover or keyboard focus, and render above the map but below creatures.
management: Separate party/storage and categorized items. Battle supplies have recovery (HP/PP), capsules, and status-cure categories; item and capture actions require explicit confirmation. Show base stats and directly editable learning values with explicit save.
